subject.title: Periodic usage-limit failures (weekly/monthly) are silently swallowed in group chats — user-copy path ignores typed FailoverError.reason

question: Which open closing PR should maintainers use to resolve this protected issue: the fuller tested copy-and-classification fix in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102643 or the narrower typed-reason-only fix in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102657?
rationale: The bug and local fix are clear, but this issue carries the protected `maintainer` label and now has two open candidate PRs, so ClawSweeper should not create a third repair or decide the PR selection automatically.

options.title: Land the fuller tested fix
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102643 as the primary resolution because it covers the typed-reason bug, non-direct regression tests, and the observed `resets` copy gap.

options.title: Land the narrow one-file fix
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102657 if maintainers want only the typed-reason classification change and prefer to leave copy wording to separate work.

options.title: Hold for manual consolidation
options.body: Ask a maintainer to consolidate the two open PRs before landing if the preferred scope is unclear.

recommendation.title: Land the fuller tested fix
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102643 as the primary resolution because it covers the typed-reason bug, non-direct regression tests, and the observed `resets` copy gap.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent delivery-policy history on the same group-silence and failure-visibility boundary makes this the best available routing owner for the PR-selection decision.
